comparison.reason: The wide design failed the centered-image error screen at the high-frequency third carrier. Use near-equal carrier radii and an intermediate spatial bandwidth.
comparison.geometry_derivation: Three conjugate pairs on an approximate hexagon: minimum center distance 74/256 = 0.2890625, exceeding twice the 0.14 decode radius.
comparison.selection: one fixed follow-up geometry derived after the development result, not an independent blind test
comparison.additional_predeclared_screen: At least 30 percent lower mean pre-to-post-optics relative L2 difference than filter_decode_001, while retaining the original balanced-4000 engineering screen.
comparison.artifact_reservation_basis: The two completed runs used less than 92 MB each; reserve 128 MiB and preserve both earlier results.
comparison.device_note: CPU float64 instead of CUDA float64 because another project started using the GPU; unchanged observation/model/decoder.
